name: Elderline - Senior Citizen Helpline 14567
department: Social Justice and Disabled Welfare Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh
beneficiary: Senior citizens aged 60 years and above in Madhya Pradesh
benefits: Information on old-age homes, pension schemes, legal guidance, and elder abuse intervention.
eligibility: Senior citizens aged 60+ or individuals calling on their behalf
required_documents: Age Proof / Aadhaar Card (if applying for pension support)
application_process: Dial 14567 to request information, guidance, or field intervention.
